Nadia: Quick sync — Prospect Pulsar is asking if we can serve Alembic-70B (custom variant with new tokenizer) in Private. They want KV cache support, Q4 quantized path, and KMS integration. Can eng confirm known gaps?
Jorge: do we have the model artifacts yet? need vocab size + hf config. also check whether their tokenizer uses 100k merges or custom special tokens.
Nadia: Not yet, sales will upload a tarball after the call today. high level asks: 1) KV cache compatibility 2) quant path (Q4_0/Q4_1) 3) tokenization parity 4) perf estimate and pricing delta for dedicated vs private.
Priya: tagging @Jorge — if kv cache layout differs we can shim but might lose prefix-cache benefits. also KMS: Private supports external KMS; we'll need customer key ARN and IAM role.
Jorge: quick probe command that helped last time:
```
python -c "from transformers import AutoConfig; c=AutoConfig.from_pretrained('path/to/model'); print(c.vocab_size, c.hidden_size)"
```
if vocab_size > 65000 we may need tokenizer remap. For quant, run a small perf pass on a 128-token sequence to compare Q8->Q4 throughput.
Nadia: timeline: sales asks for estimate by EOD Thursday. Can eng run a shallow compatibility scan (tokenizer check + one perf sample) by Wednesday? Priya / Jorge — can you own? :pray:
Priya: I can take tokenizer parity + KMS checklist. Jorge can you own quant + kv cache probe?
Jorge: yep — I'll run perf probe tomorrow. will post results + a short runbook (expected issues + mitigation).
deploy-bot: Ticket #DL-98321 created to track Alembic-70B compat scan (assignee: Jorge). See https://projects.redwood.ai/DL-98321
Nadia: perfect — once we have results we'll draft a short SOW pricing delta and a recommended deployment mode (Private vs Dedicated). Thanks team :thumbsup:
